about: Photo and signature requirements copied from official exam documents. Every exam needs a source URL, where in the document the numbers are, and the date we read it. Never add a requirement that is not in an official document. Requirements change between exam cycles, so each entry names the cycle it was read from.

exams.name: GATE 2026
exams.cycle: GATE 2026, organised by IIT Guwahati (examination in February 2026)

source.title: GATE 2026 website, Photograph and Signature page
source.location: sections Photograph Requirements and Signature Specifications (a web page, no page numbers)

notes: The website gives pixel ranges, not one size. For the photograph it gives 200 x 260 px at the smallest and 530 x 690 px at the largest, with a width to height ratio between 0.66 and 0.89. This tool uses 350 x 450 px, which is inside the range and matches the 3.5 cm x 4.5 cm shape. For the signature it gives 250 x 80 px to 580 x 180 px and a height to width ratio of 1 to between 2.75 and 3.75. This tool uses 400 x 120 px. These two sizes are our choice inside the stated ranges, not figures from the website.

The website asks for a colour photograph on a white background with the face covering 60 to 70 percent of the image, in JPEG or JPG. The signature must be in black or dark blue ink and cover 70 to 80 percent of the image.
This is the GATE 2026 cycle. A newer GATE cycle may use a different website with different numbers.

documents.name: Signature
documents.note: Sign in black or dark blue ink. The signature should fill 70 to 80 percent of the image.

exams.name: UK passport (digital photo)
exams.cycle: GOV.UK page Get a passport photo, digital photos (no update date shown on the page)

source.title: GOV.UK: Get a passport photo, Rules for digital photos
source.location: section Rules for digital photos, The quality of your digital photo

notes: The page gives a minimum of 600 pixels wide by 750 pixels tall and a file size of at least 50 KB and no more than 10 MB. This tool uses the smallest size, 600 x 750 px.

The page also says the photo must be in colour, taken against a plain light-coloured background, taken in the last month, and unaltered by computer software. If you use a photo taken on your own device, include your head, shoulders and upper body: the page says it will be cropped for you.
The page does not name a file format. This tool makes a JPG. Printed photos have different rules on a different GOV.UK page, which was not read.

exams.name: Canada passport (digital photo)
exams.cycle: Canada.ca page Passport photo requirements, online renewals (page details date 2026-09-23)

source.title: Passport photo requirements, Online renewals: Digital photo specifications
source.location: section Online renewals, Digital photo specifications: Format, size and more

notes: The page gives a 3:2 aspect ratio in portrait, at least 1,800 pixels high by 1,200 pixels wide and no larger than 4,500 by 3,000 pixels, in .jpeg or .jpg, between 200 KB and 5 MB. This tool uses the smallest size, 1,200 x 1,800 px.

The page also asks for a chin-to-crown measurement between 45 and 50 percent of the photo height, a plain white or light-coloured background, and a photo taken no more than 6 months before you apply. It says the file must be saved directly from the original file the camera captured, so use the original photo and not a screenshot or an already edited copy.
Physical photos have different rules (50 mm x 70 mm) on the same page. They are not covered here.
